question: Can unchanged three-seed head-only adaptation learn AEE structural semantics while preserving Cano performance and the frozen representation when the verified venv invocation path is preserved correctly?
method: Venv-path-semantics-only replacement for sealed V1R2. Preserve the absolute virtual-environment symlink path without dereferencing it, verify exact live versions, sorted pip-freeze and pip check, then run unchanged seeds 0/1/2 for ten epochs with 3000 AEE plus 3000 Cano train samples per epoch. Freeze encoder and embedding_head; use AEE direction F1, Cano C09 exact-tie retention, AEE role F1 and earliest epoch for selection.
baseline: Frozen AEE garage range-sector B0 is the direction baseline and each source M1D checkpoint on Cano C09 is the retention baseline. V1R2 is the immutable system-failure predecessor with zero training and no partial reuse.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable V1R3 venv-path-semantics-only replacement with unchanged data, model, seeds, training, metrics, gates and C09/C10 boundaries.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: After disclosure of the V1R2 venv-symlink failure, exact V1R3 correction, zero-data preentry proof, 23/23 tests and proposal preflight boundary, the user explicitly replied '批准'.

replacement_reason: V1R2 dereferenced the venv Python symlink with Path.resolve and therefore launched base Anaconda without venv-local Zarr; it failed before model loading with zero seeds, epochs, optimizer steps and C09/C10 reads.
system_contract_changes: Replace symlink-dereferencing Path.resolve with absolute non-dereferencing path preservation and reject relative/missing executable paths.
acceptance_criteria: V1R2 seal verifies and records zero seeds, epochs, optimizer steps, C09/C10 reads and partial reuse.
The preserved executable path remains the venv path and exact environment, live sorted pip-freeze and pip check pass before model loading.
All sources, checkpoints, tools and Data Card match; seeds 0/1/2 each complete ten epochs with exactly 3000 Cano and 3000 AEE samples per epoch.
Every seed meets AEE direction F1 at least B0, empty rate at most 0.05, count and role macro-F1 each at least 0.70, and Cano direction loss at most 0.02.
Encoder/embedding hashes and z_role probe are exactly unchanged, heads change, C09 remains retention/exact-tie-only and C10/later reads are zero.
All three seeds pass or V1R3 fails and seals without retry or partial promotion.
stop_conditions: Any parent seal, path, environment, source, checkpoint, tool, data, freeze or hyperparameter drift.
Any metric failure, nondeterministic error, CUDA failure, C09 misuse, C10/later read, timeout or disk violation.
Any retry, threshold change, partial reuse, seed deletion, teacher/model search or representation unfreeze.
expected_evidence: V1R2 failure reference and exact preserved executable/environment/pip evidence.
Per-seed histories/checkpoints, AEE outputs/metrics, Cano retention, frozen hashes, z_role probes and read counters.
Aggregate metrics, logs, progress, RUN_STATE, duration/size and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three serial RTX 5090 D head-only jobs, expected 1-2 GPU hours, internal limit 4 hours; zero simulation.
